input_profile.description: Input layout intent. completed_connectivity is a read-only terminal route; py3_preprocessed is a deprecated alias for preprocessed.

stages.description: Which part of the run to do. preprocess: every preprocessing stage, stopping before SBCI. tractography: SBCI SET tractography and SC (steps 2-5). fc: SBCI FC on the grid (step 6). Missing earlier stages always run first.

distortion_corrected_input.description: Declare that the DWI and resting-state BOLD were already distortion/eddy corrected upstream (e.g. ABCD or HCP data). The two correction stages then copy the BIDS images to the paths later stages read, run no command, and record the declaration in their markers; phase-encoding/readout metadata and Synb0 are not required.

bold_topup_fieldmaps.description: Correct the raw resting-state BOLD with the spin-echo EPI pair in fmap/ (two *_epi images with opposite PhaseEncodingDirection and a TotalReadoutTime each): topup on the pair, applytopup on the BOLD. Checked before distortion_corrected_input, so it combines with an upstream-corrected DWI. Never set it for BOLD that was already corrected upstream.

reference_scripts_dir.description: Folder of the preprocessing stage scripts. Optional; the default is this pipeline's preprocessing/ folder.

preprocessing_config.description: The dataset profile: a path, or a name relative to the pipeline such as datasets/adni/profile.conf.

consume_handoff.description: In approved preprocess mode, copy exactly the validated next-stage artifacts into the isolated SBCI work tree, verify their SHA-256 digests, record provenance, and stop before the following stage.

sh_order.description: fODF spherical-harmonic order for the fodf_tissue stage. Optional; when absent SH_ORDER from workflow.preprocessing_config applies (default 6 for one shell, 8 for several). Setting both to different values blocks the stage. The stage also blocks when the data have fewer than (L+1)(L+2)/2 unique directions.
